title.narrative: White paper on offshore wind innovation: United States-Netherlands R&D collaboration

description.narrative: This activity focuses on developing a white paper to enhance collaboration between the United States (US) and the Netherlands collaboration on offshore wind innovation.Offshore wind is a critical pillar in the global transition to sustainable energy, playing a key role in reducing carbon emissions and advancing climate mitigation efforts.The white paper will explore a specific offshore wind theme, such as turbine scale-up, supply chain integration, or floating wind technologies, through a partnership between a Dutch and an American company. By analysing shared challenges and opportunities, the paper will provide actionable insights and a roadmap for joint research and development (R&D), fostering deeper technical cooperation and policy alignment.As part of the broader efforts of the Netherlands Innovation Network, this initiative aligns with the US's missions priority to expedite offshore wind deployment and technological innovation, contributing to the global push toward renewable energy solutions.The project also builds on the outcomes of the recent Dutch Offshore Wind Innovation Mission and a newly published R&D report, creating momentum for further collaboration and tangible climate action.
